claim_text: Bryan Clark, a former Navy submariner and defense analyst at the Hudson Institute, said the Navy has 11 aircraft carriers and typically deploys two or three at a time, but could soon deploy four if the USS Theodore Roosevelt leaves San Diego for the Middle East.
quote: Clark said the Navy has 11 aircraft carriers and typically deploys two or three at a time.
confidence_justification: Named outside analyst's characterisation of fleet posture, reported by AP but not sourced to a Navy document.
